# The supervisor kills and reaps the command when sesam is killed. Signals
# addressed only to sesam are forwarded while the parent stays alive to wait.

exec git init
exec git config user.email test@sesam.dev
exec git config user.name 'Sesam Test'
exec sesam init --user admin
cp raw-fixture raw.txt
exec sesam add raw.txt
rm raw.txt

exec runprobe supervise 9 sesam run --secret RAW=raw.txt -- runprobe hold RAW ignore-term
stdout 'parent signal=9 child terminated and reaped'
exec runprobe no-temp-files

exec runprobe supervise 15 sesam run --secret RAW=raw.txt -- runprobe hold RAW
stdout 'parent signal=15 child terminated and reaped'
exec runprobe no-temp-files

exec runprobe supervise 2 sesam run --secret RAW=raw.txt -- runprobe hold RAW
stdout 'parent signal=2 child terminated and reaped'
exec runprobe no-temp-files

exec runprobe supervise 1 sesam run --secret RAW=raw.txt -- runprobe hold RAW
stdout 'parent signal=1 child terminated and reaped'
exec runprobe no-temp-files

! exists raw.txt
exec sesam id
stdout '^admin$'

-- raw-fixture --
raw
